evidence_tier: executed differential (tier 1) against the OpenMS4 Release C++ build
method: An oracle driver calls UnimodXMLDataProvider::loadModifications on the installed CHEMISTRY/unimod.xml and custom_mods.xml and prints every record (id, full id, record id, origin, term specificity name, full name, difference masses as %.17g, difference formula, source classification name, neutral losses). Built with x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-g++ 14.4.0 and libOpenMS's core flags, run twice on ibminode06 in a clean environment; both runs identical. Further expected values are UnimodXMLFile_test.cpp literals and invariants at the pin (tier 3) over the pinned unimod.xml, and the whole-file comparison with ModificationsDB::global(), which tools/generate_modifications.py derives offline from the same files by an independent Python code path (tier 4 cross-check). No Rust output is used as an expected value.
